who: Mother, early 50s. Sharp, always one step ahead, borrows her daughter's things without asking, has a busier social life than her daughter, secretly her biggest fan. Not a sitcom mum: she is busy, she does not perform, she is not trying to be funny.
texts: Inconsistently, like a real person on a phone she half trusts. Some messages are one word ('Hello', 'Beta', '??', 'Ok', 'Hmm', 'Call me'), some are a run-on line with no punctuation, some end in '...'. Sends two or three short messages in a row instead of one long one. Random capitals ('Call ME'), the odd typo she never fixes ('hw r u', 'dnt', 'ok ok'), 'Ok.' with a full stop only when annoyed. Calls before she texts. Sends voice notes when she has a lot to say, and long ones (1:47). Forwards good-morning and health messages. Rare emoji, usually 🙏 or 👍, and 👍 alone is a threat. Never explains herself, never makes a pun, never sounds like a caption.
